params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Zyra}} {{as|Seeds|buzzword2}} can be turned into plants by hitting them with her basic abilities. Enemy {{tip|champions}} can step over a {{as|Seed|buzzword2}} to destroy it.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Zyra''' plants one or two {{as|Seeds|buzzword2}} nearby that remain for some time.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Zyra''' spawns one or two {{as|Seeds|buzzword2}} nearby that last for 30 seconds, granting {{tip|sight}} over the surrounding area for 1 second.
params.description2: After 1 second, enemy {{tip|champions}} can destroy ''Seeds'' by moving on top of them.
params.description3: '''Zyra''' can only have a total of 8 ''Seeds'' planted at a time, preserving {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} spawned by ''{{ai|Rampant Growth|Zyra}}'' over {{as|Seeds|buzzword2}} spawned by ''Garden of Thorns''.
params.notes:
* {{Pending for test}}: The pattern/probability of ''Garden of Thorns'' spawning one seed or two.
* '''Zyra''' tries to plant {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} in brush and not on top of walls.
* '''Zyra''' tries not to plant {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} too close together and at different angles.
* '''Zyra''' does not plant any {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} if she is concealed within a brush (unless there is an enemy ward in it, in which case it takes her a little longer to plant the {{as|Seed|buzzword}}) or when there is no room for additional ones.
* '''Zyra''' does not plant any {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} if she is within {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 1400 units of the coordinate points (400, 400) or (14000, 14000), which are roughly at the center of the fountains on {{tip|Summoner's Rift}}.
** These same coordinates may not hold as fountain positions on other maps (e.g. on the {{tip|Arena}} map, the Magma Chamber area overlaps with the second exclusion radius) and may prompt the implementation of this behaviour to be changed in the future.{{bug}}
* '''Zyra''' tries to plant {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} close to an enemy near her.
* {{Pending for test}}: '''Zyra''' tries to plant {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} under enemy structures only if she is in basic attack range of them.
* {{Pending for test}}: '''Zyra''' tries to plant {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} on the other side of the wall she is facing and/or standing right next to.
* {{Pending for test}}: '''Zyra''' tries to plant {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} in the direction she is facing and/or moving.
* '''Zyra''' tries to plant {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} near jungle path entrances.
* {{Pending for test}}: '''Zyra''' tries to plant {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} behind herself when she is walking through the river and there are no jungle path entrances near her.
* '''Zyra''' tries to plant {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} between herself and the enemy champion she has vision of (or is heading towards her) in a 45º angle to the left or to the right depending on where on lane she is standing.
* '''Zyra''' tries to plant {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} against the inner walls of epic monster pits ({{ui|Dragon}}, {{ui|Rift Herald}}, {{ui|Baron Nashor}})
* '''Zyra''' has a hidden passive that grants her 10% increased {{tip|size}} for {{tt|33 seconds|Estimated}} after having {{cai|Sunlight|Leona}} applied to her.

blurb.plain: Innate: Zyra Seeds can be turned into plants by hitting them with her basic abilities. Enemy champions can step over a Seed to destroy it.

blurb2.plain: Innate: Periodically, Zyra plants one or two Seeds nearby that remain for some time.

description.plain: Innate: Periodically, Zyra spawns one or two Seeds nearby that last for 30 seconds, granting sight over the surrounding area for 1 second.

description2.plain: After 1 second, enemy champions can destroy Seeds by moving on top of them.

description3.plain: Zyra can only have a total of 8 Seeds planted at a time, preserving Seeds spawned by Rampant Growth over Seeds spawned by Garden of Thorns.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Zyra}} sprouts a field of thorny vines at the target location that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|{{ai|Garden of Thorns|Zyra|Seed}} Bonus:}} The {{as|Seed|buzzword2}} spawns a ''Thorn Spitter'' that inflicts {{tip|ranged}} attacks.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zyra''' sprouts thorny spines at the target location that appear after a {{fd|0.625}}-seconds delay, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
params.description2: If ''Deadly Spine'' hits a ''Seed'', it sprouts into a [[File:Zyra Deadly Spines Render.png|20px|link=Zyra#Pets]] ''[[Zyra#Pets|Thorn Spitter]]'' that lasts for 8 seconds.
params.notes: * Each [[File:Zyra Deadly Spines Render.png|20px|link=Zyra#Pets]] ''[[Zyra#Pets|Thorn Spitter]]'' will generate 2 stacks of {{ri|Conqueror}} and 1 stack of {{ri|Electrocute}}.

blurb.plain: Active: Zyra sprouts a field of thorny vines at the target location that deals magic damage to enemies hit.

blurb4.plain: Garden of Thorns Bonus: The Seed spawns a Thorn Spitter that inflicts ranged attacks.

description.plain: Active: Zyra sprouts thorny spines at the target location that appear after a 0.625-seconds delay, dealing magic damage to enemies hit.

description2.plain: If Deadly Spine hits a Seed, it sprouts into a Thorn Spitter that lasts for 8 seconds.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Zyra}} plants a {{as|Seed|buzzword}} at the target location that remains for a while. Enemy {{tip|champion|champions}} can step on the seed to destroy it and become briefly {{tip|true sight|revealed}}.
params.blurb2: '''Zyra''' periodically stocks a ''Rampant Growth'' charge, up to a maximum of 2. The charge cooldown is {{sti|cdr|reduced}} each time she kills an enemy, increased on large enemies and champion {{tip|takedowns}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zyra''' plants a {{as|Seed|buzzword}} at the target location that remains for 60 seconds and grants {{tip|sight}} over the surrounding area, though decreasing in radius after 1 second. After {{fd|1.5}} seconds, enemy champions can destroy the {{as|Seed|buzzword}} by stepping on it, which {{tip|true sight|reveals}} them for 2 seconds.
params.description2: '''Zyra''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Seed'' charge, up to a maximum of 2. Killing an enemy generates 35% charge toward a ''Seed'', increased to 100% for large enemies and whenever scoring an enemy {{tip|champion}} {{tip|takedown}}.
params.notes:
{{always quickcast}}
* Upon first rank up, ''Rampant Growth'' gains 2 charges.
* {{as|Seeds|placed}} are {{tip|untargetable}}.
* ''Rampant Growth'' cannot be learnt at level 1.

blurb.plain: Active: Zyra plants a Seed at the target location that remains for a while. Enemy champions can step on the seed to destroy it and become briefly revealed.

blurb2.plain: Zyra periodically stocks a Rampant Growth charge, up to a maximum of 2. The charge cooldown is reduced each time she kills an enemy, increased on large enemies and champion takedowns.

description.plain: Active: Zyra plants a Seed at the target location that remains for 60 seconds and grants sight over the surrounding area, though decreasing in radius after 1 second. After 1.5 seconds, enemy champions can destroy the Seed by stepping on it, which reveals them for 2 seconds.

description2.plain: Zyra periodically stocks a Seed charge, up to a maximum of 2. Killing an enemy generates 35% charge toward a Seed, increased to 100% for large enemies and whenever scoring an enemy champion takedown.

params.blurb4: {{sbc|{{ai|Garden of Thorns|Zyra|Seed}} Bonus:}} The {{as|Seed|buzzword2}} spawns a ''Vine Lasher'' that inflicts {{tip|melee}} attacks that briefly {{tip|slow}} the target.

blurb.plain: Active: Zyra shoots a surge of vines in the target direction that deals magic damage to enemies hit and briefly roots them.

blurb4.plain: Garden of Thorns Bonus: The Seed spawns a Vine Lasher that inflicts melee attacks that briefly slow the target.

description.plain: Active: Zyra shoots a surge of vines in the target direction that deals magic damage to enemies hit and roots them for a duration.

description2.plain: If Grasping Roots hits a Seed, it sprouts into a Vine Lasher that lasts for 8 seconds.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Zyra}} summons a monstrous thicket at the target location that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit as it expands.
params.blurb2: After a brief moment, the thicket snaps upward to briefly {{tip|airborne|knock up}} enemies within.
params.blurb3: All {{ai|Garden of Thorns|Zyra|Plants}} hit will gain {{as|{{sti|health}}}} and attack in double strikes.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zyra''' summons a monstrous thicket at the target location that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit as it expands.
params.description2: After 2 seconds, the thicket snaps upward to {{tip|airborne|knock up}} enemies within for 1 second.
params.description3: ''{{ai|Garden of Thorns|Zyra|Plants}}'' hit by the thicket become enraged, restoring {{as|{{sti|health|50% of their '''current''' health}}}}, increasing their {{as|'''maximum''' health by 50%}}, gaining 25% increased [[size]] and refreshing their duration while the thicket expands. Additionally they attack in a flurry, launching two shots per attack, dealing {{ft|150% damage per flurry.|75% damage per shot.}}
params.notes:
* {{ai|Garden of Thorns|Zyra|Plants}} grown during the 2 seconds prior to the displacement will also be enraged.
* {{ai|Garden of Thorns|Zyra|Plants}} already grown before ''Stranglethorns'' is cast will have their duration refreshed if they are inside the area of effect.
* ''Stranglethorns' ''buff on {{ai|Garden of Thorns|Zyra|Plants}} lasts 10 seconds, however the ''Plants'' normally die naturally after 8 seconds.

blurb.plain: Active: Zyra summons a monstrous thicket at the target location that deals magic damage to enemies hit as it expands.

blurb2.plain: After a brief moment, the thicket snaps upward to briefly knock up enemies within.

blurb3.plain: All Garden of Thorns hit will gain health and attack in double strikes.

description.plain: Active: Zyra summons a monstrous thicket at the target location that deals magic damage to enemies hit as it expands.

description2.plain: After 2 seconds, the thicket snaps upward to knock up enemies within for 1 second.

description3.plain: Garden of Thorns hit by the thicket become enraged, restoring 50% of their current health, increasing their maximum health by 50%, gaining 25% increased size and refreshing their duration while the thicket expands. Additionally they attack in a flurry, launching two shots per attack, dealing 150% damage per flurry.
